# Peak Studios

> Small puzzle and arcade games for Android, made in Godot. Contact: canalbayrak.games@gmail.com

## Games

- [Tilt Grid](https://can-albayrak.github.io/tilt-grid/): A gravity block puzzle: rotate the whole board so blocks fall, lines clear and chains grow. Short offline sessions. Status: closed test. Package: com.tiltgrid.can.
- [Fuse Chain](https://can-albayrak.github.io/fuse-chain/): A hex puzzle with a fuse: draw a path through gems, light it and set off a chain reaction. Short levels, plays offline. Status: closed test. Package: com.wildcatstudios.fusechain.
- [Cuddle Pop](https://can-albayrak.github.io/cuddle-pop/): Gentle tap-and-pop games for toddlers: big shapes, soft sounds, no reading needed. Made for parents of 1-4 year olds. Status: in development. Package: com.cuddlepop.kids.
- [SpiderBot: Neon Run](https://can-albayrak.github.io/spiderbot-neon-run/): A neon rooftop runner: a spider robot swings, climbs and parkours across a cyberpunk city. Status: closed test. Package: com.spiderbot.neon.
- [Sold! Soccer Squad Builder](https://can-albayrak.github.io/team-deal-versus/): A two-player football auction: bid on real footballers with the same budget, build a squad for the challenge and let real career stats decide the winner. Status: in development. Package: com.wildcat.kadro.
- [Project Cauldron](https://can-albayrak.github.io/project-cauldron/): A conveyor-sort puzzle: send alchemists around a track to shoot matching-color cubes, clear the board and reveal the recipe underneath. Status: in development. Package: com.peakstudios.cauldron.
